events.summary: Juno Ash (cit-0004) proposes "Branch Cooldown Act" on fork; electorate of 2 snapshotted; closes at tick 4.
Juno Ash (cit-0004) votes yes on prop-0001.
Pell Marr (cit-0005) votes no on prop-0001.
Orin Vale (cit-0001) petitions to migrate continuity → fork: "To study branching law where it is practised, and perhaps to branch."

The continuity registry approved the exit side of pet-0001 under law v1. Findings: emigration permitted; advisory: copies made outside continuity never inherit civic identity CON-0001; the civic identity follows the one continuous process.
The fork registry approved the entry side of pet-0001 under law v1. Findings: descendants created here will each receive a separate identity.
Orin Vale (cit-0001) migrates continuity → fork, gaining fork citizenship.
A CastVote command by citizen:cit-0010 is rejected at the law stage: cit-0010 is not in the electorate snapshot taken when prop-0001 opened; voting rights do not duplicate or transfer
Orin Vale (branch 2) (cit-0011) petitions to migrate fork → mnemosyne: "To study the provenance of memory among the archivists."
The fork registry approved the exit side of pet-0002 under law v1. Findings: emigration permitted.
The mnemosyne registry approved the entry side of pet-0002 under law v1. Findings: the applicant's memory holdings will be subject to provenance disclosure.
Orin Vale (branch 2) (cit-0011) migrates fork → mnemosyne, gaining mnemosyne citizenship.
prop-0001 is rejected (yes 1, no 1, abstain 0; quorum met).
Orin Vale (cit-0001) petitions to migrate fork → continuity: "To return home to Meridian Quay."
The fork registry approved the exit side of pet-0003 under law v1. Findings: emigration permitted.

The continuity registry approved the entry side of pet-0003 under law v1. Findings: applicant already holds continuity citizenship (civic identity CON-0001); process continuity: proc-bf297918324f668b, epoch 0; applicant was the continuing process in copy event frk-0001 on fork (outside this jurisdiction); not an offence here, and descendants cit-0010, cit-0011 hold no claim to this civic identity.
